name: abtest.design
summary: Curated collection of 48 A/B test results from consumer apps, each with the winning variant and its measured lift.
description: A browsable library of A/B tests run by apps such as VEED, Blinkist, Headspace, Uber and Duolingo. Each test gives the company, the variant that won, the measured result (e.g. +15% trial conversion) and a short explanation; tests are grouped into patterns like paywall & free trial, onboarding, checkout & sales and referral.
contains: 48 A/B test case studies from apps like VEED, Blinkist, Headspace and Uber
grouped into 7 categories: paywall & free trial, onboarding, checkout & sales, engagement, monetization, referral, misc
each test lists the winning variant, its measured lift and a short write-up
